name: The Software Company
archetype: A B2B software / SaaS product company — engineering, product, go-to-market

ca.full: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
ca.what: PIPEDA enforcement — how the company collects, uses and safeguards personal information, and mandatory breach reporting.
Competition and deceptive-marketing enforcement, including false-or-misleading claims in advertising and CASL's marketing provisions (shared with the CRTC).
CASL anti-spam enforcement — consent, identification and unsubscribe rules for commercial electronic messages.

uk.what: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act enforcement — lawful processing, data-subject rights, international transfers and breach notification.
Competition enforcement and merger review, including the Digital Markets Unit's conduct regime for digital firms.
Online Safety Act duties for in-scope services — illegal-content risk assessments, safety systems and transparency reporting.
